schema.description:
A Facility is a designated logical entity representing a specific business function or service capability.
While often associated with physical sites, the Facility definition itself represents the functional
requirement, independent of the specific Equipment and Materials installed. This distinction allows
the Facility’s function to endure even as physical Equipment is maintained, upgraded, or replaced over
time.
schema.title: Facility

organization_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Organization that currently controls this Facility.

name.description: The name assigned to the Facility.

geopolitical_contexts.description: The Geopolitical Contexts attribute defines the geographical or jurisdictional area in which it applies.

facility_id.description: The Primary Key of the Facility.

description.description: A long-form description of the Facility and its various functions and capabilities.

organizational_boundary_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Organizational Boundary that defines the ownership structure of the Facility.

facility_type_id.description: Foreign Key of the type used to classify the Facility.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
